blocks.text: To decline masculine and neuter nouns into the dative case, replace the ending **o** with **у**, add **у** to a consonant, or replace **й, е**, or **ь** with a **ю**. Feminine nouns decline exactly as in the prepositional case: **а** and **я** become **е**, while **ь** becomes **и**.

The dative plural is formed using the same rules that govern the instrumental and prepositional plural, albeit with slightly different endings: all nouns which end in a consonant, an **а**, or an **о**, the plural ending is **-ам**. As a memory aid, try to link the **a** and **ам**. For those that end in a **й**, a **я**, or a **е**, *and* any noun with an irregular nominative plural ending in **-я**, the ending is **-ям**. Again, try to link the **я** and the **ям**.

items: The pen moved across the letter
Why did he tell it to the policeman?
She gave money to the museum
The ship traveled about the sea
Sasha is walking towards the school
Boris won, thanks to his friends

blocks.text: Adjectives modifying masculine or neuter nouns in the dative case have the ending **-ому**. If they end in the 5-letter rule (**ш, щ, ч, ж**, or **ц**) or have the soft ending (-**ний**), their dative ending is **-ему**. Feminine adjectives have **-ой** or, after the 5-letter rule or soft ending, **-ей**. Essentially, these are the same as e prepositional endings, with masculine and neuter adjectives having an extra **-у** - the same ending most masculine and neuter nouns get.
To form the dative plural, the ending is **-ым** or, after the soft ending or the 7-letter rule (**к, г, х, ш, щ, ч**, or **ж**), **-им**.

items: Она сказала его хорошему другу Саше
She spoke to his good friend Sasha
Таня даст подарки симпатичному русскому человеку
Tanya will give the presents to the nice Russian man
They traveled across the large country

As ever, possessive pronouns conjugate almost exactly like adjectives. The third person pronouns are **его** for masculine and neuter owners, **её** for feminine owners, and **иx** for plural owners. These are the same in all cases.

exercises.q: Кровь циркулирует по ___ (кровеносный, dat. pl.) сосудам.
exercises.prompt: Blood circulates through blood vessels.
exercises.why: **кровеносный → кровеносным** (dat. pl., agreeing with сосудам). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новые: D. новым. Ending -ые → -ым.  Declension (plural): кровеносные · кровеносных · кровеносным · кровеносные · кровеносными · кровеносных.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Более опытный адвокат подступил бы к ___ (этот, dat. sg. n.) делу иначе.
exercises.prompt: A more experienced lawyer would have dealt with the case in a different way.
exercises.why: **этот → этому** (dat. sg. n., agreeing with делу). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: D. новому. Ending -это → -му (the stem changes: это-).  Declension (n.): это · этого · этому · это · этим · этом; plural: эти · этих · этим · эти · этими · этих.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: По ___ (весь, dat. sg. m.) миру люди толстеют.
exercises.prompt: All over the world, people are growing fatter.
exercises.why: **весь → всему** (dat. sg. m., agreeing with миру). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: D. новому. Ending — (no ending) → -сему (the stem changes: в-).  Declension (m.): весь · всего · всему · весь · всем · всём; plural: все · всех · всем · вся · всеми · всех.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Она была допущена к ___ (адвокатский, dat. sg. f.) практике.
exercises.prompt: She was admitted to the bar.
exercises.why: **адвокатский → адвокатской** (dat. sg. f., agreeing with практике). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русская: D. русской. Ending -ая → -ой.  Declension (f.): адвокатская · адвокатской · адвокатской · адвокатскую · адвокатской · адвокатской; plural: адвокатские · адвокатских · адвокатским · адвокатские · адвокатскими · адвокатских.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. In spite of -ш-, «большая» belongs to the guttural type: большой, большую.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
